title: NAAIL OpenLab™ V2026.4-R2: Citation & DOI-Ready Release
description: Metadata and archival-readiness follow-up to NAAIL OpenLab V2026.4-R1. This release freezes release-specific citation metadata, DOI-readiness documentation, and the distinction between public research releases and validated executable checkpoints. It does not claim independent scientific validation of registered experiments or external integrations.
notes: Release tag: V2026.4-R2. No DOI is claimed until an authoritative DOI registration service mints it.
